META_TITLE: Budgeting for Couples & Shared Finances — FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: Run money together: shared categories, a single clear budget, and a backup file you both control via your own Google Drive. Free to start, private.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Couples budgeting without the awkwardness — shared categories, one clear plan, and a backup file you both own.
PERSONA_SUBHEAD: Shared categories, one honest picture of where you both stand, and a backup file you each control — no joint account required.
SITUATION_HEADLINE: Two people, two views, one very fuzzy budget
SITUATION_BODY:
When finances are shared but tools aren't, you end up with two half-pictures and a lot of ‘did you pay that?’. Most apps assume one account and one user.

FincWin gives you one shared budget you can both see, with a backup that lives in your own Google Drive so either partner can restore it.
HOW_IT_HELPS:
• →Shared categories: agree the plan once and track against it together.
  • →One clear picture: both partners see the same numbers, no surprises.
  • →Backup you both own: sync via your own Google Drive, restore on either device.
  • →No joint account needed: works however you split the bills.
